title: Présent><Futur
longDescription: In the heart of a former arms factory, the Cité du design has become a landmark dedicated to creation and innovation. Open to professionals and enthusiasts alike, it is also a training ground for the designers of tomorrow. To share and promote design, the institution launched Present >< Future, a program of monographic exhibitions that shines a light on the French and European scene. At the core of its identity lies a logotype representing the instant “T,” a symbol of the link between present and future. With each new exhibition, the identity evolves through new shapes and colors, weaving a visual thread between past, present, and what lies ahead.
